name: Alienware FX
author: ilm
description: Alienware Command Center replacement for the Omarchy bar, plus theme-matched lighting. Fan readouts and an additive boost curve, thermal profiles, turbo and power limits, chassis RGB and per key keyboard lighting, and a Theme panel that blends a perceptual diagonal gradient from the active Omarchy theme across the keyboard and chassis. All hardware access goes through the alienwarectl helper.

barWidget.description: Fans, thermal profiles, power limits, keyboard RGB and theme-matched lighting in one panel.

schema.label: Temperature that turns the bar widget hot (C)
Bar shows, comma separated: logo, mode, cpu, gpu, fan, gpuPower
